4.name: 84. Bölüm
4.overview: Sultan Mehmed, poised to march on Rome after expanding his empire from Constantinople to the Balkans, is suddenly confronted by a deadly Papal plot on the Ottoman–Aq Qoyunlu frontier that entangles his sons Bayezid and Mustafa; as the princes are drawn into a trap along the Karasu River, rising tensions threaten to ignite a war between two great states, forcing Mehmed and Uzun Hasan to choose between ambition, anger, and statecraft while the true events at Karasu—and their bloody consequences—hang in the balance.

4.name: 85. Bölüm
4.overview: Mehmed’s march on Rome is shaken when the Karasu bloodshed sparks a crisis with the Ak Koyunlu, forcing him to balance protecting Şehzade Mustafa with defending Ottoman territory while hidden conspirators and Papal agents work to ignite war, leaving Fatih racing to uncover the plot before he’s compelled to turn his sword east instead of toward Rome.

4.name: 86. Bölüm
4.overview: Savcu’s arrest and the trap sprung on Gedik Ahmed and his men leave both empires on the brink, with envoys facing death as Mehmed hunts Saruca’s attackers and Uzun Hasan pushes toward harsh judgment, forcing Fatih to confront a web of schemes meant to halt his march to Rome and determine whether he can save his men and expose the conspiracy before it’s too late.

4.name: 87. Bölüm
4.overview: Sultan Mehmed, forced to divide his forces between Rome and the Akkoyunlu frontier, faces a crippling financial strain that sparks unrest in Konstantiniyye just as Karaman erupts in turmoil, where İshak Bey challenges Süleyman’s throne and a lethal trap awaits Şehzade Mustafa; meanwhile, Bayezid advances the Roman campaign and Uzun Hasan confronts betrayal within his palace, drawing both rulers into a web of plots that may ultimately force their paths to cross again.

4.name: 88. Bölüm
4.overview: Sultan Mehmed’s eastern crisis with Uzun Hasan pushes the Ottomans and Ak Koyunlu toward war, while Rum Mehmed Pasha’s perilous mission to Tabriz, unrest over Şehzade Mustafa, and rising intrigues in Karaman force Mehmed to confront threats to both his empire and his household as he struggles to keep alive his dream of reaching Rome.

4.name: 89. Bölüm
4.overview: Uzun Hasan’s protection of İshak pushes the Ottomans and Ak Koyunlu toward war, while Mehmed’s struggle to calm external tensions, control unrest sparked by Şehzade Mustafa, and counter secret plots from Tabriz threatens both his authority and his long‑delayed path to Rome.

4.name: 90. Bölüm
4.overview: Sultan Mehmed pushes Uzun Hasan toward peace while uncovering the conspiracy that nearly sparked war, even as new plots in Tabriz, Zeno’s looming assassination attempt, and Maksud’s revenge in Karaman threaten the fragile balance, all while Mehmed manages palace power struggles during his grandson Selim’s grand feast and strives to secure both his realm and his long‑sought path to Rome.

overview: The epic story of Mehmed II — the young Ottoman prince who defied palace enemies, survived treachery and deposition, and returned to fulfil his life's dream: the conquest of Constantinople. Spanning his rise from a doubted heir to one of history's most consequential rulers, the series unfolds across palace intrigue, battlefield warfare and a psychological chess match between two great empires. Praised as the finest Turkish historical series in years — cinematic, fast-paced and historically grounded.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Season 1 of Mehmed: Fetihler Sultanı chronicles the early rise of Sultan Mehmed II, beginning with his ascension to the Ottoman throne following the death of his brother Şehzade Aladdin and the abdication of Sultan Murad II. The season explores Mehmed’s ambitious dream of conquering Constantinople, a vision met with resistance from powerful figures like Grand Vizier Çandarlı Halil Pasha. Amid palace intrigues, shifting loyalties, and strategic alliances, Mehmed is briefly deposed but later returns to power with renewed determination. As internal enemies are purged and political tensions escalate in both the Ottoman and Byzantine courts, the season ends with Mehmed poised to fulfill his destiny, while Emperor Konstantinos XI secures his throne in Constantinople under the shadow of betrayal and manipulation

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Season 2 of Mehmed: Fetihler Sultanı intensifies the march toward destiny as Sultan Mehmed II continues his meticulous preparations to conquer Constantinople, now six months into his reign. With internal threats subdued and his vision sharpened, Mehmed strengthens alliances and refines military strategies, while Emperor Konstantinos XI, sensing the looming danger, reinstates exiled allies like Loukas Notaras and sets aside rivalries to fortify the city’s defenses. The season explores the psychological and political chess match between two empires, revealing Mehmed’s growing resolve and Konstantinos’s desperation, as both leaders brace for a confrontation that will reshape history.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: In Mehmed: Fetihler Sultanı Season 3, the story leaps forward with an eight-year time jump, showing Sultan Mehmed II firmly established in power after the execution of Çandarlı Halil Pasha and the appointment of Mahmud Pasha as Grand Vizier. While he confronts the brutal threat of Vlad the Impaler in Wallachia and continues his drive for expansion, new palace tensions emerge as a rivalry grows between Mehmed’s sons, Bayezid and Mustafa, foreshadowing future conflicts over succession. Blending political intrigue, family drama, and large-scale battles, the season highlights the costs of leadership and the Sultan’s struggle to secure both his empire and his dynasty’s future.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Season 4 unfolds as a high‑stakes epic where Mehmed’s pursuit of Rome collides with a Papal scheme that drags the Ottomans toward an unwanted eastern war; princes Bayezid and Mustafa are thrust into a deadly trap at Karasu, palace rivalries sharpen, new heirs emerge, and Mehmed is forced to choose between the dream that defines him and the empire he must protect.

title: Mehmed: Sultan of Conquests
